Lock And Strut Test
Count: 16  Wall: 2  Level: Improver

SECTION 1: LOCK STEPS, TOE STRUTS
1&2 Step forward on R, Lock L behind R, Step forward on R
3-4 Step back on L, Lock R over L
5,6 Cross R toe over L (1), Drop R heel (2)
7,8 Step L toe back (3), Drop L heel (4)

SECTION 2: FLICK, BOUNCE, SLIDE, TURN
1-2 Step forward on left, flick right behind left
3-4 Bounce heels twice while making a 1/4 turn right
5-6 Step left to left side, slide right toward left
7-8 Step forward on right, turn 1/4 right
